headline: Veranda Learning Solutions receives NCLT Chennai approval for Scheme of Arrangement
sum: Veranda Learning Solutions has obtained approval from the NCLT Chennai Bench for a Scheme of Arrangement, with the copy of the order filed with the NSE as a general update disclosure.
implication: NCLT sanction of a scheme is a gate-keeping approval that triggers statutory condition precedent for implementation; counsel must now track the scheme's effective date, shareholder/creditor objection windows, and any appeal period closure before operational mechanics commence.
detail: Veranda Learning Solutions Limited, an education technology company, filed a Scheme of Arrangement before the NCLT (National Company Law Tribunal), Chennai Bench. The Bench has granted approval to the scheme. The company has now disclosed receipt of the NCLT order copy to the stock exchange (NSE) as a material event under Listing Regulations. The order sanction is a critical condition precedent for scheme implementation.
